mapper.select: SELECT CR.ROOM_ID, CR.ROOM_NAME, CR.ROOM_TYPE, CR.ROOM_DESCRIPTION, CR.CREATED_BY, CR.CREATED_AT, CR.STATUS, CR.MAX_MEMBER, CR.IS_DEFAULT, CASE WHEN CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'NOTICE' THEN '관리자' ELSE B.BUSINESS_NAME END AS CREATOR_NAME, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM WHERE CRM.ROOM_ID = CR.ROOM_ID ) AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM CHAT_ROOM CR LEFT JOIN BUSINESS B ON CR.CREATED_BY = B.BUSINESS_NO WHERE CR.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CASE WHEN CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'NOTICE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CR.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT CR.ROOM_ID, CR.ROOM_NAME, CR.ROOM_TYPE, CR.ROOM_DESCRIPTION, CR.CREATED_BY, CR.CREATED_AT, CR.STATUS, CR.MAX_MEMBER, CR.IS_DEFAULT, CASE WHEN CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'NOTICE' THEN '관리자' ELSE B.BUSINESS_NAME END AS CREATOR_NAME, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER T WHERE T.ROOM_ID = CR.ROOM_ID ) AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM CHAT_ROOM CR JOIN CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM ON CR.ROOM_ID = CRM.ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN BUSINESS B ON CR.CREATED_BY = B.BUSINESS_NO WHERE CRM.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND CR.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'PUBLIC' ORDER BY CR.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT CR.ROOM_ID, CR.ROOM_NAME, CR.ROOM_TYPE, CR.ROOM_DESCRIPTION, CR.CREATED_BY, CR.CREATED_AT, CR.STATUS, CR.MAX_MEMBER, CR.IS_DEFAULT, CASE WHEN CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'NOTICE' THEN '관리자' ELSE B.BUSINESS_NAME END AS CREATOR_NAME, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM WHERE CRM.ROOM_ID = CR.ROOM_ID ) AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM CHAT_ROOM CR LEFT JOIN BUSINESS B ON CR.CREATED_BY = B.BUSINESS_NO WHERE CR.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND CR.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM ( ROOM_ID, ROOM_NAME, ROOM_TYPE, ROOM_DESCRIPTION, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, STATUS, MAX_MEMBER, IS_DEFAULT ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{roomName}, #{roomType}, #{roomDescription}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE, 'ACTIVE', #{maxMember}, #{isDefault} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_ROOM SET ROOM_NAME = #{roomName}, ROOM_TYPE = #{roomType}, ROOM_DESCRIPTION = #{roomDescription}, MAX_MEMBER = #{maxMember}, IS_DEFAULT = #{isDefault} WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER ( ROOM_ID, BUSINESS_NO, JOIN_DATE ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{businessNo}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT CR.ROOM_ID, CR.ROOM_NAME, CR.ROOM_TYPE, CASE WHEN #{adminFlag} = 1 THEN CR.CREATED_AT WHEN CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'NOTICE' THEN NVL(LOGIN_BUSINESS.CREATED_AT, CR.CREATED_AT) ELSE LOGIN_ROOM_MEMBER.JOIN_DATE END AS ACCESS_START_AT, CRS.LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID, NVL(CRS.LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS, 0) AS LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS FROM CHAT_ROOM CR LEFT JOIN BUSINESS LOGIN_BUSINESS ON LOGIN_BUSINESS.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} LEFT JOIN CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER LOGIN_ROOM_MEMBER ON LOGIN_ROOM_MEMBER.ROOM_ID = CR.ROOM_ID AND LOGIN_ROOM_MEMBER.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} LEFT JOIN CHAT_ROOM_READ_STATE CRS ON CRS.ROOM_ID = CR.ROOM_ID AND CRS.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} WHERE CR.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND ( ( #{adminFlag} = 1 AND CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'NOTICE' ) OR ( #{adminFlag} = 0 AND ( CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'NOTICE' OR ( CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'PUBLIC' AND LOGIN_ROOM_MEMBER.BUSINESS_NO IS NOT NULL ) ) ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN CR.ROOM_TYPE = 'NOTICE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CR.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT B.MEMBER_NO, CRM.BUSINESS_NO, B.BUSINESS_NAME AS DISPLAY_NAME, CRM.JOIN_DATE AS JOINED_AT, CRS.LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID, NVL(CRS.LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS, 0) AS LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = CRM.BUSINESS_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = B.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN CHAT_ROOM_READ_STATE CRS ON CRS.ROOM_ID = CRM.ROOM_ID AND CRS.MEMBER_NO = B.MEMBER_NO WHERE CRM.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CRM.JOIN_DATE ASC

SELECT B.MEMBER_NO, B.BUSINESS_NO, B.BUSINESS_NAME AS DISPLAY_NAME, B.CREATED_AT AS JOINED_AT, CRS.LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID, NVL(CRS.LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS, 0) AS LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS FROM BUSINESS B JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = B.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN CHAT_ROOM_READ_STATE CRS ON CRS.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND CRS.MEMBER_NO = B.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY B.CREATED_AT ASC
mapper.update: MERGE INTO CHAT_ROOM_READ_STATE TARGET USING ( SELECT #{roomId} AS ROOM_ID, #{memberNo} AS MEMBER_NO, #{lastReadMessageId} AS LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID, #{lastReadEpochMs} AS LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS FROM DUAL ) SOURCE ON ( TARGET.ROOM_ID = SOURCE.ROOM_ID AND TARGET.MEMBER_NO = SOURCE.MEMBER_NO ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TARGET.LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID = CASE WHEN SOURCE.LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS >= TARGET.LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS THEN SOURCE.LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID ELSE TARGET.LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID END, TARGET.LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS = CASE WHEN SOURCE.LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS > TARGET.LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS THEN SOURCE.LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS ELSE TARGET.LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS END, TARGET.UPDATED_AT = CASE WHEN SOURCE.LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS >= TARGET.LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS THEN SYSDATE ELSE TARGET.UPDATED_AT END WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ROOM_ID, MEMBER_NO, LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID, LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( SOURCE.ROOM_ID, SOURCE.MEMBER_NO, SOURCE.LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID, SOURCE.LAST_READ_EPOCH_MS, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
